final_topology.title: Resilient Branch Office Network
final_topology.description: Design for a branch office with redundant routers, MPLS WAN connectivity, and survivable voice capabilities.
final_topology.topology_summary: The branch office will have redundant routers connected via MPLS to the main data center. It will also have direct connections to the PSTN and a SIP provider for survivable voice functionality.

controls.title: Establish and Maintain Detailed Enterprise Asset Inventory
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'Asset Inventory System' (n_new1) connected to the primary and secondary routers, MFA/Identity Server, and Central AAA Server, indicating the presence of an asset inventory system.

controls.title: Document Data Flows
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Data Flow Documentation System' (n22) connected to the primary and secondary routers, indicating the presence of a system for documenting data flows.

controls.title: Segment Data Processing and Storage Based on Sensitivity
controls.evidence: The topology includes multiple zones (e.g., 'Data Center', 'Management Zone', 'Security Zone', 'Non-Production Zone') that are connected through specific links, indicating segmentation based on sensitivity.

controls.title: Implement and Manage a Firewall on Servers
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Firewall' (n9) connected to the primary and secondary routers, indicating the presence of a firewall on the network.

controls.title: Configure Trusted DNS Servers on Enterprise Assets
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'DNS Server' (n10) connected to the primary and secondary routers, indicating the presence of trusted DNS servers.

controls.title: Require MFA for Remote Network Access
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'MFA/Identity Server' (n11) connected to the primary and secondary routers, indicating the presence of MFA for remote network access.

controls.title: Use DNS Filtering Services

controls.title: Maintain and Enforce Network-Based URL Filters

controls.title: Establish and Maintain a Secure Network Architecture
controls.evidence: The topology includes multiple zones and specific links between them, indicating a secure network architecture with segmentation, least privilege, and availability.

controls.title: Securely Manage Network Infrastructure
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'IaC Management System' (n23) connected to the primary and secondary routers, indicating the use of Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) for managing network infrastructure.

controls.title: Centralize Network Authentication, Authorization, and Auditing (AAA)
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Central AAA Server' (n14) connected to the primary and secondary routers, indicating centralized network AAA.

controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'VPN Gateway' (n24) and 'Access Control Management System' (n25) connected to the 'Remote Access Management Service' (n_struct4), indicating the use of a VPN and connection to the enterprise’s AAA infrastructure.

controls.title: Establish and Maintain Dedicated Computing Resources for All Administrative Work

controls.title: Deploy a Network Intrusion Detection Solution
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'NIDS' (n16) connected to the primary and secondary routers, indicating the deployment of a network intrusion detection solution.

controls.title: Perform Traffic Filtering Between Network Segments
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Firewall' (n9) and specific links between zones, indicating traffic filtering between network segments.

controls.title: Manage Access Control for Remote Assets

controls.title: Collect Network Traffic Flow Logs
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Netflow Collector' (n7) connected to the primary and secondary routers, indicating the collection of network traffic flow logs.

controls.title: Deploy a Network Intrusion Prevention Solution
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'NIPS' (n17) connected to the primary and secondary routers, indicating the deployment of a network intrusion prevention solution.

controls.title: Deploy Port-Level Access Control
controls.evidence: The topology includes an '802.1X Controller' (n18) connected to the primary and secondary routers, indicating the deployment of port-level access control.

controls.title: Perform Application Layer Filtering
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'Application Firewall' (n19) connected to the primary and secondary routers, indicating the performance of application layer filtering.

controls.title: Separate Production and Non-Production Systems
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Non-Production Zone' (z5) with a representative workload (n_struct1) and a link to the 'Security Zone' (z4), indicating separation of production and non-production systems.

controls.title: Perform Periodic External Penetration Tests
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Penetration Testing Service' (n26) connected to an 'External Testing Zone External Endpoint' (n_struct2), indicating the presence of a system for performing periodic external penetration tests.

findings_before.title: ig3_missing_ig2_zone_semantics
findings_before.missing_reason: IG3 topology removed or failed to preserve IG2 zone semantics.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add the missing IG2 zone semantics to IG3 as preserved or stricter zones, with representative nodes and concrete node_links. IG3 may add controls but must not reduce segmentation.

findings_before.title: Establish and Maintain Detailed Enterprise Asset Inventory
findings_before.evidence: The topology includes various nodes and zones, but there is no explicit evidence of a detailed and up-to-date inventory of all enterprise assets, including their network addresses, hardware addresses, machine names, asset owners, and departments.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit evidence of a detailed asset inventory.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a node representing an asset management system that maintains the required inventory.

findings_before.title: Document Data Flows
findings_before.evidence: The topology includes data flow links, but there is no explicit evidence of documented data flows.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit evidence of documented data flows.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a node representing a data flow documentation system.

findings_before.title: Securely Manage Network Infrastructure
findings_before.evidence: The topology includes various network devices and links, but there is no explicit evidence of version-controlled IaC or secure network protocols.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit evidence of secure management practices.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a node representing a version-controlled IaC system.

findings_before.title: Ensure Remote Devices Utilize a VPN and are Connecting to an Enterprise’s AAA Infrastructure
findings_before.evidence: The topology includes a Remote Access Management Service (n_struct4) but does not explicitly show a VPN connection.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit evidence of a VPN.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a node representing a VPN and links to the remote access management service.

findings_before.title: Manage Access Control for Remote Assets
findings_before.evidence: The topology includes an MFA/Identity Server (n11) and a Remote Access Management Service (n_struct4), but there is no explicit evidence of managing access control based on specific criteria.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit evidence of access control management.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a node representing an access control management system.

findings_before.title: Perform Periodic External Penetration Tests
findings_before.evidence: The topology includes an External Testing Zone (z6) but does not explicitly show evidence of periodic external penetration tests.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit evidence of periodic external penetration tests.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a node representing a penetration testing service and links to the external testing zone.
